caption: The drawing depicts a quilt with a square composition. The outer border features a wide band of pink fabric decorated with a floral or botanical pattern. Inside the border, the central area of the quilt is made up of a cream or off-white background divided into a grid of squares, each quilted with diagonal lines forming diamond shapes. Arranged within this central area are four large circular patterns resembling stylized flowers with pointed petals, each made from alternating green and blue patterned fabrics around a central patch of pinkish-brown fabric. There are also four large quarter-circle patches of pinkish-brown, textured fabric, one in each corner, and four smaller quarter-circle patches of very pale blue fabric positioned next to the larger corner circles. The arrangement of the "flower" and partial circle patterns creates a regular, symmetrical visual balance within the overall rectangular composition of the quilt.
title: Infant's Quilt (Bed Covering)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
